meta.title: The record — Nagy Habib
meta.description: Selected papers, a book and invited lectures by Professor Nagy Habib: first trials in gene therapy, stem cells and small activating RNA, and radiofrequency liver resection.

sections.label: The record
sections.sub: Selected papers, a book and invited lectures. 430 journal articles, 27 book chapters and 9 books in his ORCID record.
